title: Layer 3 round 4 major SE+QE convergent: registry free-form strings truncation_mark, absence_text, marker_word, broken_state_mark still reach the terminal uncleaned — the rest of the #791 class; fix once at load

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 800878a5: registry display strings are cleaned once at load via a PostLoad hook the generic loader runs after deserialization — StatuslineData::post_load cleans truncation_mark, broken_state_mark, every display_field absence_text, every degraded_kind marker_word/next_step_text, and every read_failure_kind human_diagnostic/human_recovery; the other set types take the no-op default. Every downstream surface (segment, human, machine) now receives clean data, so no render site can miss a member of the class — the machine form included, which the render-site approach could not reach. The two redundant per-sink cleans round 3 added (next_step, human_recovery) are removed for a single mechanism. Pinned by a post_load unit test asserting every field is cleaned.
